Paths are relative to the standard package, never absolute local paths. Workflow #407 LOAD-1: also actinglab package loading's --packs-root holding no pack directory (path packs).

package_bundle_write_failed.description: A package bundle directory could not be written: write failed. Workflow #407 LOAD-1: also a pack's loading copy that actinglab package loading --write could not write; the message names the file and the files already written, and nothing is removed.

package_bundle_navigation_package_invali.description: Workflow #373 NAV-T (M-373 v1.1 §3.9): a package that a standard-pack root file names (the feature package of pages.json, an edge or recovery chain step of navigation.json, a handler or then.run package of interrupts.json) cannot play its part, as the Runtime would refuse it with contained_task_navigation_package_invalid: same navigation_role and navigation_problem. package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check report it; admission_failed carries the loader's refusal as its cause.
package_bundle_navigation_package_invali.common_causes: The feature package's pages are not exactly the page list; an edge's package does not start on its from page or end on its to page, or is an application entry; a recovery chain, handler or then.run package declares a prerequisite package; a handler's entry does not hold its interrupt page; a package's declarations keep it from a layer (recognize_only, stability termination, post-admission OCR, readings, a designated operation, an on_empty select step).
package_bundle_navigation_package_invali.handling: Fix the root file or the named package so that it fits its part, then bundle or check again.

package_bundle_entry_page_unlisted.description: Workflow #373 NAV-T (M-373 v1.1 §4.4, §10.1 NAV-4): a pack's entry pages are not all pages of pages.json (page_ids lists those that are not), so the Runtime does not navigate to the pack's entry and records contained_task_navigation_entry_unlisted instead. package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check list one per such pack: the report the resource CI reads.
package_bundle_entry_page_unlisted.common_causes: The page list does not list the pack's entry page yet, or the pack names its entry page by another id than the list's.
package_bundle_entry_page_unlisted.handling: Add the page to pages.json and its feature package, or align the pack's entry page id with the list.

recognition_pack_undeclared.description: Workflow #384 D2-S2 (transitional warning): a pack of a bundle generated with maintenance declarations only navigates and reads (it qualifies as a recognition maintenance package), and the declarations name no recognition package for its server (variant). Workflow #411 A32: only the one package a server declares counts, so the other qualifying packs of a server that declares one raise nothing. The resource repositories make it an error once their recognition packages are declared (D2-S6).
recognition_pack_undeclared.common_causes: A server of the standard package declares no recognition maintenance package in maintenance.json.
recognition_pack_undeclared.handling: Declare, for each server, its one recognition maintenance package with the use recognition.

selection_policy_limit_exceeded.description: A resource conversion read a selection policy document above its size limit.

package_bundle_remedy_invalid.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md, contracts/package-reference.md): a package's remedy cannot be served inside its game root (remedy_problem capability_unprovided: no package of the root provides the capability a remedy names; cycle: the packages' remedies and provided capabilities form a cycle, one entry per package on it; parameters_mismatch: two providers of one capability declare different parameters). need, capability and outcome_key name the remedy where they apply. package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check list one entry in warnings per finding; nothing is refused, and the Runtime stops such a remedy for a person at run time.
package_bundle_remedy_invalid.common_causes: A provider package not written yet or not listed in bundle.json.
package_bundle_remedy_invalid.handling: Add or fix the provider package, or remove the capability from the remedy.

package_bundle_interrupt_page_shadowed.description: Workflow #411 B35 (contracts/package-reference.md, the standard-pack cross-check; contracts/README.md, shared interrupt pages): a package of the game root declares page_id, which interrupts.json lists as a shared interrupt page. A page a package declares is its own, so that shared interrupt page does not act for the package's runs, and adding it to interrupts.json changes nothing for them. package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check list one entry in warnings per package and such page; a feature package of pages.json and a handler of that page declare it by their part and are not listed. Nothing is refused.
package_bundle_interrupt_page_shadowed.common_causes: The package recognises the dialog itself, written before the shared interrupt page existed.
package_bundle_interrupt_page_shadowed.handling: Remove the page from the package so that the shared interrupt page handles it, or keep it when the package must handle that page itself.

package_bundle_store_tap_unlocated.description: STORE-FG-1 (design-store-fg §8.1; contracts/resource-declarations.md, store update packages; contracts/package-reference.md, the standard-pack cross-check): a package of the game root declares store_update, and the store operation pack_operation_id taps a fixed place (click kind point, rect or specific_rect) rather than a target located on the frame. A store's buttons move between devices and layouts, so such a tap can land on another button. package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check list one entry in warnings per package and such operation. Nothing is refused: kernel admission still takes the package.
package_bundle_store_tap_unlocated.common_causes: The store step was written from one device's frame with the button's position.
package_bundle_store_tap_unlocated.handling: Tap a text target located on the frame (click kind target or offset with a verify_text guard on the button's own label).

package_bundle_preprocess_divergent.description: Workflow #428 CFL-2 (contracts/recognition-preprocess.md, Hand-over; contracts/selection-graph.md, Shared OCR read): an OCR target that a fixed_slots layout's slots or features read lies inside the layout's shared read with its model and languages, but its preprocess chain differs from the shared read's (two chains are the same only step by step, colors in their declared order), so it reads on its own instead of taking its text from the shared read. json_pointer names the shared read in the package's recognition pack (/candidate_layouts/<i>/shared_ocr). package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check list one entry in warnings per package, target and shared read. Nothing is refused.
package_bundle_preprocess_divergent.common_causes: The chain was edited on the shared read or on the slot target only, or copied with its colors in another order.
package_bundle_preprocess_divergent.handling: Copy the shared read's preprocess to the target verbatim, or remove it from both, unless the target must read on its own.

adopt_refused.description: Workflow #464 P1 (contracts/standard-pack-authoring.md, "The checks"): actinglab standard-pack adopt refused before it wrote anything in the repository, adopt_problem naming the check: repository_invalid (entry the file of --repo that is missing or does not read: applications.json, maintenance.json, packs, schedule.json, or a .part of one an interrupted adoption left, the message naming every leftover and what to do; or, without a decision and with --replace, entry maintenance.json, json_pointer the package's entry and package_id, when schedule.json gives the package a held entry beside that entry: two roles, which only an adoption interrupted between its two renames leaves, the message saying what to do; a rule beside that entry is the package's one maintenance role, since the composer does not judge it), recording_not_current (path the recording's recording.json, member the member that is not as a stopped recording's last stop left it: schema_version, record_id, status, amended_at_unix_ms or artifact), package_invalid (path the package; the loader's refusal as the cause, or package_id when it names no directory packs/<package_id>), package_mismatch (member game or server: the package's is not applications.json's), pack_exists (entry packs/<package_id>, or json_pointer the rule or held entry of an earlier adoption without --replace, the message naming what the root files hold of the package and, when schedule.json and maintenance.json hold nothing of it beside its directory, naming the root file adopt does not write that gives it a role and what the call accepts for it, or saying that an adoption was interrupted before it wrote them, and what to do; entry packs/<package_id>.part an interrupted adoption left, the message naming every leftover and what to do; path a kept copy's place that is taken), pack_dirty (entry packs/<package_id>, count the paths with a change not committed, or the version control's failure as the cause), recording_unreviewed (package_id: the package is not run through, its cross-check not passed, its first decision not evaluated or a step needing review, and the class is not held; the refusal's details carry review), local_path (entry the package's file, json_pointer the string, which holds an absolute local path or the state directory), decision_invalid (path the decision document and json_pointer the member, or entry schedule.json and json_pointer in the file as it would be written for what the rule keeps: a member missing or wrong, a business rule without its value that is no follower of a chain, pending for a follower, the class business beside a maintenance role a root file adopt does not write gives the package, or a key the schedule as the check compiled it reads of the rule's own outcome (a composed rule's trigger or feedback_stop, a pool's observation, an activity target's measure), or a key the rule reads of another task's outcome, that the package of the task read does not declare, the message naming who reads by its id and the details carrying that package's declared_outcome_keys and, for another task, its task_id and package_id), value_origin_model (path the decision document, json_pointer /value/origin: the value names the origin model, which only the model's export writes; give the number with the origin pack, or pending), rule_refused (entry schedule.json, json_pointer the composer's pointer in the file as it would be written, the composer's refusal as the cause; or package_id when the adopted package comes out unclassified), root_file_not_canonical (entry schedule.json or maintenance.json, which adopt must change and which is not in the canonical form package fmt writes), replace_across_volumes (entry packs/<package_id>, path the kept copy's place: with --replace the state directory lies on another volume than the checkout, where the replaced directory cannot be moved, or the volume cannot be told, the failure as the cause; the message says to give a --state-dir on the checkout's volume, and a recording's package by --package), check_tree_unmarked (path the checkout's check tree under the state directory, which holds no marker the tool wrote: it is not the tool's own and is not touched), check_tree_busy (path the check tree, which another adoption of the checkout with the same state directory holds), check_tree_link (path the check tree's place, or a directory beside it named as one a call makes the tree whole in, which is a link, a symbolic link or a junction: nothing is cleared through it), business_rule_in_the_way (entry schedule.json, json_pointer /rules/<i> and package_id: a decision of the class maintenance by its uses alone meets the package's business rule, a rule the composer judges by its value, which adopt does not turn into a maintenance rule; the message names the rule's id). A refusal of package bundle or standard-pack check of the check tree other than these is answered as it is.
adopt_refused.common_causes: A decision document without a member the class needs, a package adopted before without --replace, a recording whose cross-check was only partly evaluated, a root file formatted by hand.
adopt_refused.handling: Fix what the value names and run the adoption again; it wrote nothing. A root file that is not canonical is written in the canonical form once, in a commit of its own.

adopt_write_failed.description: Workflow #464 P1 (contracts/standard-pack-authoring.md, "What it writes"): a write of actinglab standard-pack adopt failed: path where it stopped (a file or directory of the check tree, of the repository or of the kept copy), paths what it had written or moved before, in order; the operating system's refusal as its cause. Or it stopped because schedule.json or maintenance.json changed after the call read it (path that file, no cause): it renames nothing more and overwrites no other call's work, and the message says what to do. Both root files are written whole as their .part before the first is renamed, the one that gives the package its new role first. When the new pack directory cannot take the place of a replaced one, the old one is moved back and the message says so. Nothing is removed in the checkout: a .part left behind and a kept copy stay where they are.
adopt_write_failed.common_causes: Another adoption or a person changed a root file during the call; a file held open by another program; a full disk.
adopt_write_failed.handling: Read the paths, restore the checkout with the version control where it changed, move a .part away by hand, and run the adoption again.

package_dispatch_waiting.description: Workflow #464 P3 (contracts/standard-pack-schedule.md, Readiness): a pack of a game root is not dispatched yet for one readiness item: readiness_item names the item (S1 to S7 of the game root, I1 to I6 of an installation), readiness_problem why. Its values make it actionable: game and server; task_id the rule (value_pending, value_undeclared, head_waiting, pair_suspended) and pool_id the pool without a valuation; page_ids the entry pages nothing reaches; required_revision the bundle's declared package maximum beside range_min and range_max, the installation's range (revision_outside), or the revision what the game root carries asks (revision_undeclared); instance_id the suspended pair's instance; model_name the model not installed; blocking_package_id the pack another one waits for (fix round 1: the head's pack of head_waiting, the refused layer of prerequisite_unregistered and prerequisite_refused, the pack standard-pack check refused the root at for root_refused; fix round 2: the return-home package of return_home_refused). The other check's own outcome is its caused_by link where one exists: package_invalid with the loader's refusal (admission_refused), standard_pack_package_unclassified (unclassified), standard_pack_benefit_undeclared (value_undeclared), standard_pack_root_invalid of schedule.json (composition_refused, requires_unknown), the kernel's prerequisite code (prerequisite_unregistered, prerequisite_refused, return_home_refused), the refusal of standard-pack check (check_refused, root_refused; and admission_refused or composition_refused when the check refuses for their kind), the refusal of place at the edge, standard_pack_root_invalid with notice_undeclared, goal_undeclared or variable_undeclared (revision_undeclared). actinglab standard-pack ready answers one per failing item of each pack; nothing is refused.
package_dispatch_waiting.common_causes: The pack's value is not decided yet (pending), no rule names it or it is held, its prerequisite chain or the return-home package its home entry takes is one the Runtime refuses, standard-pack check refuses its game root, the head of its chain waits, no instance is bound to its game, the Runtime is older than the pack needs, the bundle declares a package revision below what it carries, one of its pairs is suspended, a model it needs is not in the vision root.
package_dispatch_waiting.handling: Act on the named item: decide the rule's value, write or release its rule, repair the prerequisite chain, the return-home package or the game root as the cause says, make the head's pack ready, bind an instance, place the bundle on a Runtime whose package range holds it, build the bundle again so that it declares the revision of what it carries, add the subsystem's Runtime, repair the pack so that its pair's pause lifts, install the model; then ask again.

package_readiness_unjudged.description: Workflow #464 P3 (contracts/standard-pack-schedule.md, Readiness): a readiness item of a pack that was not judged from what the readiness was given, readiness_unjudged saying why (installation_not_read: no installation was read; part_not_read; not_admitted; composition_refused; no_rule; server_not_told; package_undeclared; check_stopped), never guessed and never passed; or, item unrecorded_screen_code (I3) only, the information line no_revision_tells, which never makes a pack wait (the coordinator's ruling 3 on board #464). An item not judged never counts as holding: a pack whose root items all hold and none of whose items fails, with an installation item not judged, answers ready_to_place, not dispatchable (fix round 1).
package_readiness_unjudged.common_causes: The readiness ran without an installation (actinglab standard-pack ready reads none), or a part of the installation was not read.
package_readiness_unjudged.handling: Act on the item it depends on where there is one. An installation item is judged only where an installation's readings are handed to the function; today no caller hands them (actinglab standard-pack ready reads none, and the placement plan does not call the readiness yet, a follow-up), so judge it by hand: the configuration's instances (I1), the installer's package range (I2), check-config's subsystems (I4), actingd suspended (I5), vision check (I6).

trial_authorization_missing.description: Workflow #463 S3-10 (contracts/standard-pack-trial.md, "The refusals"): actinglab standard-pack trial names no authorization: --authorization is absent or blank. A trial on a real application is an act under the owner's explicit authorization, so the tool requires its reference before it reads anything; it records the reference and never interprets it. Nothing was read, written or sent.
trial_authorization_missing.common_causes: The command line or the MCP call left out --authorization, or gave an empty or blank value.
trial_authorization_missing.handling: Give --authorization <reference>, the reference of the owner's word (for example the board comment that holds it), and ask again.

trial_package_not_directory.description: Workflow #463 S3-10 (contracts/standard-pack-trial.md, "The package"): the --package of actinglab standard-pack trial names a file (path), a .zip or .json container or any other, not a package directory. Adoption rewrites a package's JSON into the canonical form, so a container and the directory adopted from it may hash differently, and what is tried must be what is adopted: a trial runs a pack directory, packs/<id> of a checkout or a placed pack. Nothing was written or sent.
trial_package_not_directory.common_causes: The container record stop wrote was given before it was adopted.
trial_package_not_directory.handling: Adopt the package (actinglab standard-pack adopt) and give its directory packs/<id>, or the placed pack's directory.

trial_irreversible_unacknowledged.description: Workflow #463 S3-10 (contracts/standard-pack-trial.md, "The irreversible mark"): the game root given as --root (path) counts the package (package_id) as able to do something irreversible, by the contract crate's IrreversiblePackages over every package the root registers (a package the root does not register, and every package while one of the root cannot be read, counts so), and --irreversible is not given. Without --root the mark is not judged and this refusal cannot happen. Nothing was written or sent.
trial_irreversible_unacknowledged.common_causes: The package provides a capability a package of the root marks irreversible, or a remedy of its mappings lists one; or the root does not register the package, or holds a package that cannot be read.
trial_irreversible_unacknowledged.handling: Make sure the owner's authorization covers an irreversible trial of this package, then ask again with --irreversible as well.

trial_expectation_unknown.description: Workflow #463 S3-10 (contracts/standard-pack-trial.md, "The plan"): the --expect of actinglab standard-pack trial names no outcome key the package (package_id) declares in its entry task's scheduling_outcome mappings; the details carry the key given (expected) and the declared keys (declared_outcome_keys). Nothing was written or sent.
trial_expectation_unknown.common_causes: A key misspelt, or one of another package; a package that declares no mapping.
trial_expectation_unknown.handling: Give one of the declared keys, or leave --expect out.

trial_state_dir_refused.description: Workflow #463 S3-10 (contracts/standard-pack-trial.md, "The record"): the state directory (path) where actinglab standard-pack trial keeps its records is, or lies inside, a repository or an installed root (trial_state_place says which: a directory along its path holds .git, or the Lab's markers of an installed root, runtime\BUILD-MANIFEST.json or install\active.json). Trial records are Lab authoring state, kept beside the recordings. The plan and the record's writer both refuse it; nothing was written or sent.
trial_state_dir_refused.common_causes: --state-dir points into a resource repository's checkout or into the installation root.
trial_state_dir_refused.handling: Give a --state-dir outside every repository and installation, or leave it out for actinglab's own.

trial_record_write_failed.description: Workflow #463 S3-10 (contracts/standard-pack-trial.md, "The record"): a trial record could not be written at path, or a record of its name, or the .part of one, is there already and is never replaced; the operating system's refusal (or AlreadyExists) is its cause. Nothing is removed: a .part a failed write left stays where it is.
trial_record_write_failed.common_causes: A full disk or a folder without the right to write; two trials of one content recorded in the same millisecond; a .part left by an interrupted write.
trial_record_write_failed.handling: Read the cause, free the place (move a left .part away by hand), and write the record again.

trial_record_unreadable.description: Workflow #463 S3-10 (contracts/standard-pack-trial.md, "The record"): a file of a trial record's name (<content12>-<ms>.json) under <state>/trials/<package_id>/, or that directory, could not be read (the operating system's refusal as its cause), is larger than 1 MiB, does not decode as actingcommand.pack-trial.v1 (the decoder's refusal as its cause), or is not the record of the package, the content and the time its name says. The reader answers no record of that package rather than pass over one.
trial_record_unreadable.common_causes: A record edited or copied by hand, or a file of another program under the trials directory.
trial_record_unreadable.handling: Look at the file the path names; restore or move it away, then read again.
